**Record** in the `Latiprimere` namespace, from the [Latiprimere.Abstractions](/docs/reference/#latiprimereabstractions) package.

```csharp
public sealed record PrintOptions
```

Describes how a print job should be printed.

Settings left at their defaults use the printer's own defaults. Settings the printer does not support are handled by the print system, which may ignore them or reject the job.

## Constructors

```csharp
public PrintOptions()
```

## Properties

### Collate

```csharp
public bool? Collate { get; init; }
```

Gets whether copies are collated, each copy whole before the next (1, 2, 3, 1, 2, 3), or not, each page's copies together (1, 1, 2, 2, 3, 3); or `null`, the default, for the printer's default.

It matters only with more than one [PrintOptions.Copies](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/printoptions/#copies). The Windows spooler collates unless this is `false`.

```csharp
public ColorMode ColorMode { get; init; }
```

Gets whether to print in colour or monochrome.

### Copies

```csharp
public int Copies { get; init; }
```

Gets the number of copies to print. Defaults to one.

**Exceptions**

- [ArgumentOutOfRangeException](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.argumentoutofrangeexception): The value is less than [PrintOptions.MinimumCopies](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/printoptions/#minimumcopies).


Gets whether to print on one or both sides of the paper.

### Finishings

```csharp
public IReadOnlyList<Finishing> Finishings { get; init; }
```

Gets what to do to the printed sheets, such as staple them; empty, the default, for the printer's default, which is usually nothing.

Use the printer's [PrinterCapabilities.Finishings](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/printercapabilities/#finishings). The Windows spooler doesn't apply them yet: a Windows printer refuses a job that sets them with [NotSupportedException](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.notsupportedexception), and its driver's stapling is reached with a `windows:feature:` vendor option. The list is copied when set, without repeats, and record equality compares it by reference.

**Exceptions**

- [ArgumentNullException](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.argumentnullexception): The value is `null`.

### InputTray

```csharp
public InputTray? InputTray { get; init; }
```

Gets the paper source to print from, or `null` to use the printer's default.

Use one of the printer's [PrinterCapabilities.InputTrays](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/printercapabilities/#inputtrays): tray IDs only mean something to the printer that reported them. Trays are matched by [InputTray.Id](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/inputtray/#id). The Windows spooler refuses a tray the printer's driver doesn't list with [NotSupportedException](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.notsupportedexception).

### JobName

```csharp
public string? JobName { get; init; }
```

Gets the name shown for the job in print queues, or `null` to let the print system choose.

### MediaSize

```csharp
public MediaSize? MediaSize { get; init; }
```

Gets the paper size to print on, or `null` to use the printer's default.

Use one of the printer's [PrinterCapabilities.MediaSizes](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/printercapabilities/#mediasizes), or a size made with [MediaSize.Custom](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/mediasize/#custom) inside one of its [PrinterCapabilities.CustomMediaSizes](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/printercapabilities/#custommediasizes). Listed sizes are matched by [MediaSize.Name](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/mediasize/#name) only. The Windows spooler refuses a size the printer's driver neither lists nor takes as a custom size with [NotSupportedException](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.notsupportedexception); IPP printers and CUPS decide for themselves, and may print on another size.

### MediaType

```csharp
public MediaType? MediaType { get; init; }
```

Gets the kind of paper to print on, such as labels or photo paper, or `null` for the printer's default.

Use one of the printer's [PrinterCapabilities.MediaTypes](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/printercapabilities/#mediatypes), matched by [MediaType.Id](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/mediatype/#id). The Windows spooler refuses a type the printer's driver doesn't list with [NotSupportedException](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.notsupportedexception).

### OutputBin

```csharp
public OutputBin? OutputBin { get; init; }
```

Gets where to deliver the printed sheets, or `null` for the printer's default.

Use one of the printer's [PrinterCapabilities.OutputBins](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/printercapabilities/#outputbins). The Windows spooler doesn't apply it yet: a Windows printer refuses a job that sets it with [NotSupportedException](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.notsupportedexception).

### OutputFile

```csharp
public string? OutputFile { get; init; }
```

Gets a file to print to instead of the printer's device, or `null` to print normally.

Supported by the Windows spooler, where it is required for virtual printers such as Microsoft Print to PDF in applications without a user interface. Print systems that can't print to a file throw [NotSupportedException](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.notsupportedexception) when this is set, rather than ignoring it.

### PageRanges

```csharp
public IReadOnlyList<PageRange> PageRanges { get; init; }
```

Gets the pages to print, counted from 1, in order and without overlapping; empty, the default, for all of them.

Where Latiprimere renders the pages, as on the Windows spooler and for raster, it renders only these. A printer or CUPS queue sent a PDF as it is is asked for them, with IPP's `page-ranges`. Text and images count the pages Latiprimere lays out. Pages past the end of the document are left out; ranges that leave no pages at all fail the job with [ArgumentException](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.argumentexception) where Latiprimere renders it.

Raw data's pages can't be seen, so a raw job with page ranges is refused with [NotSupportedException](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.notsupportedexception). The list is copied when set, and record equality compares it by reference.

**Exceptions**

- [ArgumentNullException](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.argumentnullexception): The value is `null`.
- [ArgumentException](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.argumentexception): The ranges are out of order or overlap, such as 3-5 then 4.

### Quality

```csharp

```

Gets the print quality: draft, normal or high.

### Scaling

```csharp
public ScalingMode Scaling { get; init; }
```

Gets how an image is sized on the paper: by default, shrunk to fit if it is larger, otherwise at its own size.

It applies to images, from [PrintContent.FromJpeg](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/printcontent/#fromjpeg) and [PrintContent.FromPng](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/printcontent/#frompng), and is ignored for other documents.

### VendorOptions

```csharp
public IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> VendorOptions { get; init; }
```

Gets settings for one print system only, which the other options don't cover, such as print quality, stapling or a driver's own settings. Empty by default.

Each key starts with the print system that reads it, and each print system ignores the others' keys:

- `ipp:`, read by CUPS and by network printers: an IPP attribute, such as `ipp:print-quality` = `5`. Values separated by commas are several values. Integers, `true` and `false`, keywords and names are recognised; collections such as `media-col` are not.
- `cups:`, read by CUPS only, and sent the same way: a CUPS option, such as `cups:fit-to-page` = `true`.
- `windows:devmode`, read by the Windows spooler: a DEVMODE saved from the same printer's driver, encoded in base64, used for PDF jobs instead of the driver's defaults.
- `windows:print-ticket`, read by the Windows spooler: a Print Ticket in XML, which the printer's driver merges onto the driver's defaults, or onto `windows:devmode`, for PDF jobs. It reaches the driver's own features as well as the Print Schema's. Other `windows:` keys are refused with [NotSupportedException](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.notsupportedexception).

These settings aren't portable between print systems, or often between printers: use the typed options where they exist. A key that sets something a typed option already sends, such as `ipp:copies` with [PrintOptions.Copies](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/printoptions/#copies), is refused when the job is submitted. The dictionary is copied when set, and record equality compares it by reference.

**Exceptions**

- [ArgumentNullException](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.argumentnullexception): The value, or one of its values, is `null`.
- [ArgumentException](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.argumentexception): A key doesn't start with `ipp:`, `cups:` or `windows:` followed by a name.


### MinimumCopies

```csharp

```

The smallest number of copies a job can request.

Declared before [PrintOptions.Default](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/printoptions/#default) because static fields are initialised in declaration order.
